extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Torogao, the NTRanch character-animation editor and engine: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) serving the one tool registry (57 tools) for realtime 2D puppet projects — project inspection and validation, rig templates and export, governed expressions and characters, audio and viseme work, physics and effects, GLB expression mapping, scenes and Playroom sessions, tracking, video timelines, and writer and tutorial tools. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Torogao does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Torogao

skills.description: Inspect INP/INX projects (census, metadata, node tree, parameters, parts, textures), read container-only project information, and run the structural validation gates with stable TG- findings; the project-writing apply-fixes tool is declared disabled pending its write gate.
skills.name: Project inspection and validation

skills.description: List rig templates and physics-chain presets, instantiate a template into a new INP puppet file, and export a project to the lumen-rig model format with a reasoned conversion report.
skills.name: Rig templates and export

skills.description: Create character projects from lane packs and governed states, check expression coverage against a pack's governed set, list stored states and variants, apply a state or variant in preview, and read lane-pack, rating-stamp, and consent-model information.
skills.name: Characters and governed expressions

skills.description: Bake, render, and validate deterministic procedural audio recipes, list the SFX library, validate voice records, analyze WAV audio into lip-sync viseme proposals, and author, bake, check, and validate viseme tracks against the mouth-parameter contract.
skills.name: Audio, viseme, and voice

skills.description: Run the deterministic fixed-step physics preview under a scripted input track, compile and validate torogao-effects stacks against a project's live parameters, and simulate scene fluids against hit areas.
skills.name: Physics and effects

skills.description: Read a GLB container's nodes, meshes, skins, morph targets, and animations; check that every governed expression maps to morphs the GLB has, and resolve one governed expression to its morph weights.
skills.name: GLB and 3D expression mapping

skills.description: Read and validate scene documents, author and list hit areas and motion events, create and open Playroom sessions, update and compose session snapshots, and list, apply, and save preference sets.
skills.name: Scenes and Playroom sessions

skills.description: Build and render session documents into audio recipes and rendered output, validate session documents, check tracking-set coverage, validate tracking takes, and bake tracking takes to curve sets.
skills.name: Sessions and tracking

skills.description: Build a torogao-timeline from a clip list, validate timelines, measure cuts against the tempo beat grid, and export edit-decision artifacts (ffmpeg concat list, JSON EDL, chapters).
skills.name: Video timelines

skills.description: Build canon-grounded writer scaffolds and gated model-lane scene drafts (a canon gap returns the gap instead of drafting), and list tutorial lessons, run lesson checks, and read tutorial progress.
skills.name: Writer and tutorials
